entries.text: Fixed QuestDB read_primitives window_moving_frame failing with 'impossible type cast, invalid type': RANGE window frames written with an INTERVAL bound are now rewritten to QuestDB's quoted duration syntax (`RANGE BETWEEN '30' day PRECEDING`), and the QuestDB catalog variant keeps the final ORDER BY outside the RANGE window, which QuestDB 10.0.1 rejects with 'RANGE is supported only for queries ordered by designated timestamp' when the outer ORDER BY has more than the designated timestamp.
